consulted_citations.field: 大部; PDF p. 922, printed p. 907; headword, form chart, explanation
consulted_citations.text: The scan shows the 大部 section and headword 大 dà, followed by a chart labeled 商, 西周, 春秋, 战国, 秦, 《说文》小篆, 汉 and 楷书. The explanation calls 大 pictographic, describes the oracle-bone and bronze forms as a frontal person with arms extended and legs apart, proposes ‘adult’ as the original sense, and relates ‘big’ to it. This is the book’s analysis; its dated semantic sequence is not established by the passage. The entry continues onto PDF p. 923, which was not inspected in this invocation.
